scope: Bounded synthetic fixed-attitude original P63 engine/PIPA/navigation experiment. No achieved burn attitude, historical trajectory, full descent or landing is established.

sampling.method: sample and hold only; no interpolation, extrapolation or browser physics
sampling.cpuClock: t = actual native cycle × 12 / 1024000 seconds; not historical GET
sampling.physicalClock: physicalTimeSeconds is the recorded external plant elapsed time from the initialized state epoch (120 s); it is separate from CPU replay time and AGC TIME2/TIME1
sampling.sourcePointers: Each changing field preserves its actual source rawLine/cycle. A frame combines last-known asynchronous observations; it is not one simultaneous sensor packet.

dskyScope: Original channel 010 digit relay output. Register sign lamps and indicator channels are not decoded by this inherited digit-only decoder; no signs or lamps are invented.
limitations: Retained crew steps are experiment transactions, not Apollo 11's historical mission checklist.
CDUs and body attitude remain fixed. A commanded attitude display is not an achieved physical attitude.
Nominal instantaneous engine response and guidance pulse-to-force scale are model assumptions, not flight-calibrated engine dynamics.
Live arbitrary DSKY input, cockpit mode interlocks, coupled free attitude, translation controls and complete descent are not exposed by this recorded adapter.

events.title: Recorded cockpit discretes set
events.description: The harness sets active-low engine ARM, AUTO throttle, G+N control and ATT MODE AUTO hardware inputs. These are recorded fixture transactions, not an interactive cockpit.

events.title: Checklist continuation
events.description: Original P40AUTO checklist is continued through the recorded V33E transaction.

events.description: Actual retained key sequence. E means ENTR; V33E is a recorded verb transaction, not a claim that the PRO key was pressed.

events.title: Awaiting original ignition request
events.description: The engine is armed but remains off. A crew enable request and actual engine-on output are separate observations.

events.title: V99 N62 · crew enable request
events.description: Original Luminary requests crew permission. This display is not engine ignition; the recorded continuation is V33E.

events.title: Recorded DSKY · V33E
events.description: Actual retained key sequence. E means ENTR; V33E is a recorded verb transaction, not a claim that the PRO key was pressed.

events.title: Original IGNITION routine
events.description: This source checkpoint identifies original instruction execution; the engine-on output is separately observed.

events.title: Original ENGINE ON output
events.description: Original Luminary's actual channel 011 output now commands engine on. V99 crew permission occurred earlier.

events.title: Original P63IGN continuation
events.description: Original powered-descent ignition continuation executes.

events.title: Physical thrust enabled
events.description: This is an actual external plant observation, separate from the original command output.

events.title: Physical acceleration produces PIPA counts
events.description: The external physical sensor quantizes actual engine-derived specific impulse. Gravity is not fabricated as accelerometer thrust feedback.

events.title: PIPA counter packet delivered
events.description: An actual engine-derived counter-operation packet reaches the original AGC. The retained source includes its bounded coupling delay.

events.title: Original navigation consumes thrust feedback
events.description: At this actual MUNRETRN observation, original Luminary navigation has consumed the physical engine-derived PIPA counts.

events.title: Original P63ZOOM
events.description: Original P63 transition logic executes in the bounded diagnostic.

events.title: Original FLATOUT
events.description: Original Luminary loads the 4096-count throttle command; genuine external clock pulses deliver it.

events.title: Original throttle DOIT
events.description: Original throttle instructions execute; no browser throttle calculation is substituted.

events.title: Bounded engine experiment
events.description: The retained P63 diagnostic horizon has been reached. It does not complete powered descent or a landing.

events.title: Recorded DSKY · V37E00E
events.description: Actual retained key sequence. E means ENTR; V33E is a recorded verb transaction, not a claim that the PRO key was pressed.

events.title: Original ENGINE OFF output
events.description: Original software output removes the engine-on request; physical force-off and later crew disarm are separately observed.

events.title: Physical thrust stopped
events.description: This is an actual external plant observation, separate from the original command output.

events.title: P00 · software shutdown
events.description: Original P00 has commanded ENGINE OFF. The incomplete automatic-counter reset is preserved rather than fabricated as a full reset.

events.title: Recorded hardware input · channel 030
events.description: documented crew disarm; external DECA reset only; exact active-low packet is retained.

events.title: Crew disarm
events.description: A separate external engine DISARM input clears the external accumulator after the original software shutdown.

events.title: Retained experiment ends
events.description: The native run ends after P00 and crew disarm. No lunar landing or subsequent mission phase was executed.
